name: Forgotten Ironmine
description: An abandoned mine occupied by Grak'Zul's goblin forces. Clear the chambers to reach the chieftain.
visualTheme: A collapsing wooden structure diving deep into red-clay tunnels, littered with broken lanterns, minecarts, and goblin shields.

history.createdWhy: Built to extract high-grade iron ore under royal charter.
history.majorEvents: Overrun by the Blood-Club goblin clan during the vanguard retreat.
history.whyExists: Represents the deepest mining vault in the Foothills region.
history.currentConflicts: The Goblin Chieftain Grak'Zul coordinates foothills raids from the central chamber.
